name: HMAC
description: Creates a hash-based message authentication code (HMAC)
syntax: HMAC( object message, object key, [string algorithm], [string encoding] )

params.name: message
params.description: The message to be hashed. Can be a string or a byte array.

params.name: key
params.description: The secret cryptographic key to be combined with the message and hashed. Can be a string or a byte array.

params.name: algorithm
params.description:
The algorithm to use for hashing your input, default is `HmacMD5`.

The available algorithms (depending on your JVM) are

- HmacSHA512
- HmacSHA3-384
- HmacSHA384
- HmacSHA3-512
- HmacSHA512/256
- HmacSHA3-224
- HmacSHA512/224
- HmacSHA3-256
- HmacSHA256
- SslMacMD5
- HmacSHA224
- SslMacSHA1
- HmacSHA1
- HmacMD5

params.name: encoding
params.description:
The character encoding to use when converting the message to bytes. Must be a character encoding name recognized by the Java runtime.

* utf-8
* iso-8859-1
* windows-1252
* us-ascii
* shift_jis
* iso-2022-jp
* euc-jp
* euc-kr
* big5
* euc-cn
* utf-16
